subject: Commercial routing & FinOps gating: hosting preference and procurement flow
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@altavista.ai>, Josh Patel <josh.p@altavista.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + procurement routing (post-demo)

Hi Emma / Josh — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and the asks we agreed on: 

- Altavista needs a clear procurement path before legal signs off: PO vs card vs marketplace purchase.
- Hosting preference: your infra team is leaning toward Dedicated for production latency, but wants a short proof-of-concept on Hosted to validate throughput.
- Commercial options to consider: 12-month commit (discounted), monthly on-demand, or a burstable reserved pool.

Next steps I promised:
1) Send a concise decision matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private and the corresponding procurement route recommendations.
2) Provide a draft quote that maps to both PO (net30) and credit-card options.
3) Share a simple checklist for procurement (SOC 2 evidence, invoice samples, SOW pointers).

Attached: initial decision matrix + example quote (draft). Let me know if procurement prefers marketplace purchases (Azure/AWS marketplace) — that changes the billing path and timing.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Redwood-Hosted-vs-Dedicated-Decision-Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: Redwood-Quote-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Emma Liu <emma@altavista.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Josh Patel <josh.p@altavista.ai>
Cc: procurement@altavista.ai
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement routing (post-demo)

Thanks Monica — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: we prefer PO / net30 for anything above $25k ARR. Card is OK for pilots <$5k.
- Marketplace: we generally avoid marketplace purchases for multi-year committed deals because our internal finance team flags them for different GL codes and it delays recognition. That said, if the hosting needs to be behind our Azure tenancy we may need marketplace to enable certain private link integrations.
- Hosting: infra team confirmed Dedicated for prod, but we'd want a 2-week Hosted soak test first. If Dedicated, we'd likely do a 12-month commit with the option to increase capacity mid-term.

Please make the quote show both: (A) PO net30 12-month commit pricing, and (B) month-to-month on-demand pricing card/PO. Also include a short note about lead time for Dedicated provisioning and any SLA/uptime commitments.

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Platform Engineering, Altavista AI
emma@altavista.ai
[procurement@altavista.ai was CC'd]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@altavista.ai>, Josh Patel <josh.p@altavista.ai>, procurement@altavista.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement routing (post-demo)

Emma — great, thanks for the clarity. Attached is an updated quote with three line items: Hosted (on-demand monthly), Hosted (12-month commit), Dedicated (12-month commit) with expected provisioning lead times. Also included: a short procurement checklist and SOC 2 link.

Highlights:
- Dedicated 12-month commit: 25% discount vs hosted on-demand; typical provisioning 7-10 business days after PO sign + capacity schedule.
- Hosted 12-month commit: 18% discount, immediate start, reserved vCPU/GPU profiles available.
- On-demand: no commitment, higher unit price, immediate.

Action items for Altavista (suggested):
- Confirm procurement vehicle: PO (preferred) or marketplace. If PO, send PO template (we can populate invoice details).
- Confirm whether your legal needs a dedicated SOW (we can attach a minimal SOW).
- Confirm target start date for the 2-week Hosted soak.

I've looped in Markus to confirm if there are any extra commercial flexes we can provide for an initial 12-month commit (discount stacking / onboarding credits).

Attachments: Redwood-Quote-v2.pdf, Altavista-PO-template.docx

Best — Monica
[Attachment: Redwood-Quote-v2.pdf (pdf)] [Attachment: Altavista-PO-template.docx (docx)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@altavista.ai>, Josh Patel <josh.p@altavista.ai>, procurement@altavista.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement routing (post-demo)

Thanks everyone — quick internal note and final asks before we lock pricing: 

- Commercial: we can offer an additional 5% one-time onboarding credit for a 12-month committed Dedicated contract (RDW-4721). That would be applied on first invoice.
- Marketplace: if Altavista confirms a marketplace purchase is required for private link reasons, pricing will need a small uplift (5-7%) to account for platform fees; we should surface that explicitly in the quote.
- SLA: Dedicated includes a 99.9% uptime target in the SLS; Hosted commit has 99.5% with optional premium SLA add-on.

Emma / procurement team — if PO is the path, Monica will populate the PO fields on your template and circulate for signature. If you want the DocuSign path we can prepare that as well (link below).

Final ask: please respond with the chosen procurement vehicle and confirm the target start week for the Hosted soak test so we can reserve capacity.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
[Related DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/prepare/RDW-4721]
